<div id="bayes-demo" class="bayes-layout">

<div class="bayes-panel">

<label class="bayes-control">
<span>m₀</span>
<input
  data-param="priorMean"
  type="range"
  min="-3"
  max="3"
  step="0.1"
  value="0">
<span data-value="priorMean"></span>
</label>

<label class="bayes-control">
<span>s₀</span>
<input
  data-param="priorSd"
  type="range"
  min="0.3"
  max="3"
  step="0.1"
  value="1.2">
<span data-value="priorSd"></span>
</label>

<label class="bayes-control">
<span>x̄</span>
<input
  data-param="observedMean"
  type="range"
  min="-3"
  max="3"
  step="0.1"
  value="1">
<span data-value="observedMean"></span>
</label>

<label class="bayes-control">
<span>n</span>
<input
  data-param="n"
  type="range"
  min="1"
  max="200"
  step="1"
  value="20">
<span data-value="n"></span>
</label>

</div>

<div class="bayes-plots">

<div class="bayes-plot">
<svg class="bayes-histogram"></svg>
</div>

<div class="bayes-plot">
<svg class="bayes-density"></svg>
</div>

</div>

</div>

<script>
bayesUpdateDemo("#bayes-demo");
</script>
